prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original BODY illustration for an editorial feature on Taian shadow-puppet theatre, formally called 皮影戏（泰山皮影戏）. Not a website screenshot and not a replacement for the existing first-screen image.

Primary request: ONE original art composition built from the luminous translucency of a single imagined cut-leather shadow puppet, sparse openwork, a dark stone plane and warm screen light. This is AI creative illustration, not documentary photography, a real antique or museum object, a historical reconstruction, a real artisan's work, or evidence of actual puppet-making or operating techniques.

Subject: ONE full, unnamed theatrical puppet in profile, with a restrained abstract headdress and an original simple robe silhouette. Use amber and muted oxblood-red translucent leather-like surfaces with a low density of clean organic cutouts. Backlight travels through the thin material and openwork, creating a warm glow against a charcoal/slate-grey stone-textured area. Leather has subtle matte grain, thin edges and uneven hand-shaped colour, not plastic, glass, jewellery or metallic filigree. No famous character's identifying facial pattern, weapon, crest or signature costume. The stone is a neutral invented material plane, not a named cliff, inscribed stele or sacred object.

Style and lighting: dimensional mixed-media art illustration with carefully controlled tactile depth, thin translucent leather, sparse cut edges, dark low-relief stone and a concentrated amber light opening. Rich dark-to-warm contrast, mostly charcoal, smoke-grey, deep reddish leather and honey light. A closer material study with a clear vertical focal silhouette, not an airy ink landscape, cut-paper river map, basket-weave circle or glossy product photograph. No named artist imitation.

Composition: ONE complete native landscape 3:2 image, ideally 1536 by 1024 pixels. Show the whole puppet inside the central 38 percent of width and central 64 percent of height, with headpiece, limbs and feet clearly separated from surrounding dark material. A broad quiet dark stone plane and an unframed angled/vertical light opening create an asymmetric background; do not use scenic mountains or a monumental theatre panorama. Keep the essential cut-leather figure and glow together near the centre for mobile crops. Use generous physical separation and low-density cutouts, not all-over decorative noise. No frame, border, mockup mount, contact sheet or multiple panels.

Authenticity boundaries: create a new imaginary figure rather than copying a real shadow puppet or Fan Zheng'an's or another maker's named work. Do not show step-by-step production, exploded construction, detailed mechanical joints or a functional control-rod scheme. Any pose, texture, cutout and shadow are artistic invention and must not be asserted as actual regional craft facts.

Text: NONE. No letters, Chinese characters, titles, calligraphy, signatures, seals, logos, watermarks, labels, museum tags, inscriptions or pseudo-writing.
Avoid: real people or hands, multiple puppets, tools, archaeological wear claims, factual stage reconstruction, rivers, reeds, weaving, pottery, tourists, mountains, buildings, UI, browser, phone, buttons or playback icons. The result is one uninterrupted cultural-art illustration, clearly unlike a reed-fibre and torn-paper estuary collage.
timePrecision: 原记录起止时间及偏移原样保留
